irregularities.title: No parcel address, APN/AIN, or coordinates supplied (by privacy design)
irregularities.detail: Without a private offline parcel identifier, exact Census tracts, ZIMAS zoning, frontage AADT, FEMA flood zone, CGS fault/liquefaction zone, and CAL FIRE FHSZ cannot be determined. Every parcel-specific cell is left blank and marked unverified.

irregularities.title: Lease expiration stated only as a 5-year range (2030–2035) with no executed lease file
irregularities.detail: Contract rent, rent bumps, option counts, notice deadlines, NNN structural/tax carve-outs, ROFR, and franchisee guaranty are unverified externally.

irregularities.title: No owner adjusted basis, accumulated §1250 depreciation, debt balance, or filing bracket
irregularities.detail: Turns verified IRS/FTB tax rules into mechanics + a local browser calculator rather than a published dollar figure.

irregularities.title: No verified arm's-length short-lease QSR quote set or debt term sheets
irregularities.detail: Official government/SEC sources do not publish private Central LA QSR cap-rate quotes; the short-lease discount slot (TX-09) is left strictly blank until 3 BOVs and 2 debt quotes are collected.

irregularities.title: 'Central Los Angeles' is not an official Census, BLS, or municipal boundary
irregularities.detail: City of LA (469 sq mi) and LA County (9.84M residents) averages mask sharp neighborhood variation; parcel-specific Census tracts must be locked offline via ZIMAS + Census API.

irregularities.title: Direct HTTP fetch to U.S. Census QuickFacts failed on 2026-11-26
irregularities.detail: Both dual-geography and single-geography QuickFacts URLs returned fetch errors today. Per strict verification policy, zero QuickFacts values are marked verified in portal-02817d04 (TA-15 left blank); CA DOF E-1 (SRC-02) is used for verified 2025/2026 population & housing instead.

irregularities.title: Direct HTTP fetch to finance.lacity.gov transfer-tax FAQ failed on 2026-11-26
irregularities.detail: While CA RTC § 11911 ($0.55/$500 county rate, SRC-24) and LAHD's >$5M Measure ULA threshold (SRC-25) were verified directly, CPI-adjusted FY2026 ULA tier cutoffs on finance.lacity.gov could not be fetched directly today and remain user-editable in the calculator.

irregularities.title: Three different official LA City population figures appear across repository trees
irregularities.detail: /docs/ cites Census Vintage 2024 (3,878,704); /pages/ & /workspace/ cite Census QuickFacts July 1, 2025 V2025 (3,869,089); CA DOF E-1 reports Jan 1, 2025 (3,839,536) and Jan 1, 2026 (3,806,201). All are official, but DOF explicitly warns they measure different dates and methodologies and must not be mixed.

irregularities.title: Conflicting model back-test status across trees (Reconciling Flag F-20)
irregularities.detail: /pages/ reports a completed 47-quarter macro HPI back-test (r = -0.937), whereas /audit/ marks cash-flow back-testing BLOCKED. Both are accurate for separate layers: residential macro HPI can be back-tested (confirming mean reversion), while parcel-level QSR NNN cash-flow back-testing remains strictly BLOCKED.

irregularities.title: Prior unconfirmed $20.00/hr CA fast-food wage (IR-A3) verified on official CA DIR page
irregularities.detail: Session arena-78005353 could not reach CA DIR during its pass; on 2026-11-26 we fetched dir.ca.gov/dlse/Fast-Food-Minimum-Wage-FAQ.htm directly, confirming AB 1228's $20.00/hr statutory minimum for chains >=60 units effective April 1, 2024.

irregularities.title: BLS October 2026 labor/payroll figures are preliminary (p) & Oct 2026 YoY CPI-U is blank
irregularities.detail: BLS marks Oct 2026 labor force and CES employment preliminary; Oct 2026 12-month CPI-U % change is omitted on the official BLS table due to the Oct 2025 collection lapse (Sept 2026 YoY +3.7% is latest annual rate).

irregularities.title: CAL FIRE 2026 SRA Fire Hazard Severity Zone maps are in active public comment (Nov 9, 2026 – Jan 8, 2027)
irregularities.detail: Any private FHSZ lookup performed during late 2026 must record both the 2025 LRA effective map and whether any adjacent SRA boundary is under revision.

irregularities.title: SEC EDGAR disclosures measure Jack in the Box Inc. systemwide, not PARCEL-001's franchisee
irregularities.detail: 93% of Jack in the Box restaurants are franchised (1,979 of 2,128 at Q1 FY2026). Systemwide -7.0% franchise SSS and 50–100 guided closures elevate credit scrutiny, but unit-level profitability is unknown without private store statements.

irregularities.title: LA County Decline-in-Value (DIV) filing deadline is November 30, 2026 (4 days from 2026-11-26)
irregularities.detail: Verified on assessor.lacounty.gov/proposition-13: 2026–2027 DIV applications close Nov 30, 2026.
